scope: Source-derived in-memory query execution over 100 prebuilt records, including clock/context construction, link-index construction, evaluation, sorting, exact totals, and 50 result rows; excludes source loading, authorization, canonical request preflight, serialization, and process startup

build.patch: Prepared execution programs and benchmark committed with this artifact
build.profile: Cargo release defaults; no profile overrides or RUSTFLAGS

method.fixture: 100 deterministic in-memory task records, open status, ascending titles, no links; status equality filter, title selection/order, limit 50 and exact total 100
method.cache_state: prebuilt records and structured plan; no disk cache; no result memoization
method.compile_per_candidate: Test-only uncached evaluator compiles the expression at every evaluation, matching the prior execution path
method.prepared: One execution compilation during warmup, reused across candidates and requests; all candidates still evaluated
method.timing_end: After checking count, row count, and diagnostics; before result destruction

limitations: Not the public 10K/100K acceptance corpus or end-to-end host/CLI gate
Canonical request preflight still separately compiles expressions for validation
Not SQLite execution, incremental derivation, selective hydration, or a retained authorized collection session
CPU frequency, power state, and unrelated host activity uncontrolled; one sequential development-machine run
No memory-growth, concurrency, cold-start, or durable-write evidence
